selection_protocol: Seed 0 only. Every method receives the predeclared Task-1 candidate budget and is selected by Gaussian NLPD with RMSE as the tie-breaker; formal spatial splits 5-9 are not opened for capacity selection. ST-SVGP, Bui OSGPR and OVC-SVGP use the 38-fit/4-validation spatial split. Bui OSGPR and OVC-SVGP share a three-grid Task-1 budget whose macro-average winner is 8x32. If a method cannot complete the full formal stream at its Task-1-selected capacity, it is reported in the failure table; it is not replaced in the primary benchmark by a lower-capacity result. The official complete-output LMC/IMC/FSDE family shares one M,Q choice using a 48-week history plus four chronological Setting B validation weeks, because these models cannot fit a 38-output subset and then represent the held-out output dimensions without changing their official likelihood. This validation-geometry exception is explicit.

common_rules.formal_refit: After selection, refit with all 52 Task-1 jurisdictions before the delayed Setting B stream.

routeb_ordinary_vs_cumulative_hippo.rule: Exact match: both are the same Route-B Kronecker representation, differing only in the temporal state update.

st_svgp.rule: Tune only spatial inducing points. The temporal state-space representation is replicated through time and has different semantics from Route-B Mt x Ms.

shared_selection.criterion: macro-average Task-1 validation Gaussian NLPD across OVC-SVGP, controlled Bui OSGPR and adaptive Bui OSGPR; RMSE and smaller grid break ties

bui_osgpr_and_ovc_svgp.rule: Use the Task-1-selected Cartesian 8x32 time x space inducing grid for OVC-SVGP, controlled Bui OSGPR and adaptive Bui OSGPR. This exact grid match is appropriate because all three retain point-inducing representations over the same time-by-space input domain. OVC-SVGP is reported as resource-limited when its official exact-fantasy continuation cannot finish at that capacity; completed 4x32 archives are non-primary feasibility evidence only.

lmc_imc_svgp_and_fsde_svi.rule: LMC-SVGP, IMC-SVGP and FSDE-SVI must share the selected temporal inducing count M and latent rank Q. The LMC/IMC Task-1 temporal validation selected M=4, Q=2; FSDE-SVI inherits and validates that frozen shared pair. Because the pinned official multi-output likelihoods require every output to have historical labels, use only Task 1's final four chronological weeks under the same 42-visible/10-hidden conditional-prediction protocol. This exception is explicit and does not open formal seeds 5-9.
